intro: Work, relax, repeat—without clutter. Raffin shifts from a coffee table into a raised desk with hidden storage, giving you comfort, order, and bold style wherever your day takes you.

features.title: Lift-up design that adapts to you
features.text: Switch seamlessly from lounging with coffee to working on your laptop, letting one table flex to your changing needs in the same space.

features.title: Hidden storage for a clutter-free look
features.text: Tuck away books, chargers, or remotes inside the lift-up top, keeping your room looking neat while essentials stay close at hand.

features.title: Compact footprint, maximum use
features.text: Sized to fit modern apartments, it gives you desk-level function without taking up extra room, making small spaces feel bigger.

features.title: Black finish that adds bold edge
features.text: The deep black tone anchors your space with modern elegance, pairing easily with contemporary furniture for a striking centerpiece.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
